thread.topic: Banned For Playing by the rules ?

posts.subject: Banned For Playing by the rules ?
posts.bodyHtml:
Found out I was banned while i was not on the server bij ramius or something like that ?
Pretty werid though, I always enforce the rules and keep telling players to not shoot from spawn/spawnkilling, You can ask well known/populair players in there like plofoko etc.


However I killed a guy once or twice because he was shooting me on top from their spawn. As the new rules states ( which has been changed 1,5/2 months ago: NEW - You are ALLOWED to spawnkill ONLY if : N°1 : The enemy IS in YOUR spawn N°2 : If the enemy IS shooting you when he IS NOT ALLOWED TO SO !


I CAN shoot them if they shoot me on top from their spawn, So i did.


Now my question is, Did ramius not do his homework by banning me for an old removed rule ( cause before the change you where not allwed to shoot them, or shoot the enemy in your spawn )


I really like playing on your server, Any i'm trying to prevent players from breaking the spawnkilling/shooting from spawn rule, And then I get banned While i was not in the server for spawnkilling, Which i never did ? Execept for shooting back the person that was shooting me from their spawn ?
Maybe it was a mistake, m8, admins are also humans and humans do mistakes, i dont know what happend but maybe a mistake

How can a ban be Accidentally ?
you just can't ban someone accidentally, Or you really didn't took your time to ban someone or payed no attention to it ?


I'm admin is multiple games in the =(eGO)= Clan Also in the csgo Servers, You just don't ban someone accidentally,
I know It could happen, But then he must have been in a rush so he overlooked it or pressed or copy'd wrong.
I'm not mad or something, but its pretty frustrating i cant play on my fav rpg surf server for something i didnt do.

Here your Ban.


Its not a big Deal, you will be unbanned in 4 Hours (10:30) just go out have a drink and come back and your ban will be vanished 🙂

Zitat von HardcoreLegend

Can you tell me your ingame name?



edit: found you

ahh, Good But what was the reason, I wasn't even online at the time you banned ?


As far as i know Scar and Dutch something where spawnkilling all the time when I was playing.
Elfke or something was shooting from spawn, That was the guy I shot back twice.
Well i saw 2 people spawnkilling that was you and Scar. Im not sure but i think you were the one on top of the tower across the spawn. And you were on the server.

Lol You really have to check better before banning, I was shooting plofoko which was standing on top of the teleport to top above spawn, Never shot anyone from there in spawn, I only been there twice, once i got rekt by plofoko and the second time there was nothing to shoot because the whole ct was shooting top and the jumpers from t spawn...


I was never IN their spawn, only shot the guy that was shooting me FROM spawn, Never fired 1 shot at all the other people spawning.


I did shot 2 guys that jumped out of spawn and where almost on the surf ramp or where already at the surf ramp, But according to fiddles thats allowed because they left spawn, So i did nothing wrong ?


And just besides that, Since when there are no warnings given ?
I gived some warnings but it could be that you couldnt hear it because i was in spec and were not inside the enemy spawn i saw that you were shoot inside the spawn from a tower.

The only person i've been shooting from the tower was plofoko which was on top and a guy jumping down which was surfing or barely surfing like I said in the post above, You might Spectated someone else or whatever, But I've never been spawnkilling, And I never will, I'm always enforcing those rules, you can ask that to more populair players like plofoko, Dutch courage, Fiddles , Sniffle etc etc
